AI-Mini-Drama-P9-01.title: Credit pill leaves a generating chat with no leave dialog
AI-Mini-Drama-P9-01.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent] AI Mini Drama: Credit pill opens My Credits mid-generation with no leave dialog
AI-Mini-Drama-P9-01.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Tap AI Mini Drama on the Launcher
3. Tap Create Your Drama
4. Type an idea (e.g. A night-shift baker and a lost delivery cyclist save a bakery)
5. Tap Send
6. Tap English
7. Tap Yes, include captions
8. Tap Generate
9. Tap the credit pill while 「Thinking…」 is shown
10. Check the result

Result:
The credit pill opens My Credits at once with no Leave this chat? dialog; the outline keeps generating and is saved.
摘要：大綱生成中點擊點數膠囊直接開啟我的點數，未顯示「Leave this chat?」，大綱在背景繼續生成並被儲存。
{16.9.0_amd50_newchat_asks.jpg} {16.9.0_amd50_pill_no_dialog.jpg} {16.9.0_amd50_saved_anyway.jpg} {16.9.0_amd50_storyboard_pill.jpg}

Expect Result:
Like Back and New chat, the credit pill first asks 「Leave this chat?」 (storyboard: 「Stop and lose your credits?」).
摘要：點數膠囊應與返回、新聊天一致，先顯示離開確認對話框。
Spec string: 「Leave this chat?」 / 「Your story outline isn't ready yet, so this chat won't be saved.」

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama Design spec, 1016_Chat navigation frame - https://www.figma.com/design/dZk5HLzZTdcZwWwvN9aZfZ/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=4858-34930
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama PM spec (AI Mini Drama - PM Spec 20261021.pdf), Main flow board - https://www.figma.com/design/44RyrcOcWi2MvhGci9bO5F/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2016-2
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-P9-01.qa_note: R-261/R-262 (Design 1016_Chat navigation 4858:34930, PM main flow §3.2/§3.3; REQ-029): while the outline or a short job generates, every top exit (Back, History, New chat, credit pill) asks first. On 189872 Back, History and New chat ask; the credit pill never does. TC-357: outline generating, New chat → 「Leave this chat?」 (correct); credit pill at 16:00:18 and 16:01:35 → My Credits at once, twice. TC-358: credit pill 16:03:08 → My Credits, no dialog, so no Leave anyway; the outline kept running behind My Credits (turn end 16:03:42 ok) and History lists 「Reading the Tide」, which should have been discarded. TC-359: storyboard generating on Bound Pages 00:08:05 → My Credits at once; History and New chat both showed 「Stop and lose your credits?」. All Pink fault switches Off. No log line for the guard (the pill is client navigation). Not the same as DRI261894P0049 (Back vs History icon) or DRI261896P0048 (Back during storyboard).

AI-Mini-Drama-P9-02.title: Iris replies show locale codes such as ja_JP and en_US
AI-Mini-Drama-P9-02.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent][UI] AI Mini Drama: Iris replies show internal locale codes like ja_JP and en_US
AI-Mini-Drama-P9-02.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Tap AI Mini Drama on the Launcher
3. Tap Create Your Drama

5. Tap Send
6. Tap Japanese

Replies name the language as the format card does (English, Japanese) with no locale code.
摘要：回覆應以格式卡上的語言名稱（English、Japanese）稱呼，不顯示語系代碼。

[AI Recommendation]
I have completed the storyboard script in Japanese.
Video language is set to English with captions on.

AI-Mini-Drama-P9-03.title: Partial character failure uses the single-failure dialog
AI-Mini-Drama-P9-03.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent][UI] AI Mini Drama: Partial character failure shows the single-character error dialog

Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Tap AI Mini Drama on the Launcher

{16.9.0_amd52_single_copy.jpg} {16.9.0_amd52_after_gotit.jpg} {16.9.0_amd52_no_mark.jpg} {16.9.0_amd52_update_whole_failure.jpg} {16.9.0_amd52_log.txt}

A partial failure shows 「Couldn't create some images」 with the number of failed characters, failed slots marked !.

Spec string: 「Couldn't create some images」 / 「N characters couldn't be created. Your credits have been refunded. Tap a character to try again.」

[AI Recommendation]
Title: Couldn't create some images
Body: 1 character couldn't be created. Your credits have been refunded. Tap a character to try again.

AI-Mini-Drama-P9-03.qa_note: R-035 / R-294 (PM Update board 3): when some characters fail, 「Couldn't create some images」/「N characters couldn't be created. Your credits have been refunded. Tap a character to try again.」, failed slots keep 「!」. (1) All Pink fault switches Off, Borrowed Rain Generate all ◆8 16:54:50: Leo failed (TextToImage NSURLErrorDomain -1001 16:56:33), Clara made → 「Couldn't create image」/「We couldn't create this character and your credits have been refunded. Try again later.」 (the single-character copy) with Leo's red 「!」 on the sheet; Got it opened Choose for Leo (no frame of the sheet in this run; text recorded at 16:57). (2) Pink › [z] AI Mini Drama › Trip image moderation ON 17:08–17:39: both failed (serverFailed 4000) → the same single copy for two characters (TC-042-result); after Got it neither slot carries 「!」 in Choose Character or in 「2 characters aren't set yet」 (TC-384). (3) TC-353 chat 「Update characters」 for two (Trip image moderation ON, but the failure was a real storage PUT error, no injection line): Julian updated, Clara failed, the turn ended as a whole failure 「Something went wrong on my end.」 and Clara's slot has no 「!」. AI-Mini-Drama-P9-06.title: Confirming the cast charges character credits with no offer card
AI-Mini-Drama-P9-06.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent] AI Mini Drama: Confirming the cast charges character portraits with no offer card, then fails
AI-Mini-Drama-P9-06.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Tap AI Mini Drama on the Launcher
3. Tap History
4. Tap a drama whose characters are all set
5. Read the balance on the credit pill
6. Tap a character slot
7. Tap ✓
8. Wait for Iris's reply
9. Tap Back until the Launcher is shown
10. Tap Mine
11. Tap Credits
12. Tap Details
13. Check the result

Result:
Confirming the cast books −34 credits of Text to Image/Speech with no offer card, then ends in Something went wrong.
摘要：確認角色後未出現報價卡即扣除 34 點（文字轉圖片/語音），之後顯示「Something went wrong」。
{16.9.0_amd55_after_done.jpg} {16.9.0_amd55_failed.jpg} {16.9.0_amd55_ledger.jpg} {16.9.0_amd55_video_131.jpg} {16.9.0_amd55_log.txt}

Expect Result:
Confirming the cast offers 「Create storyboard」 with its price; nothing is charged until Generate is tapped.
摘要：確認角色後應出現附價格的「Create storyboard」卡，點 Generate 前不應扣點。
Spec string: 「The characters look great! Ready to create the storyboard?」

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama PM spec (AI Mini Drama - PM Spec 20261021.pdf), Chat result states (top mockup group) board - https://www.figma.com/design/44RyrcOcWi2MvhGci9bO5F/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2016-2
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-P9-06.qa_note: R-037 (PM Chat result states): with every character set, Iris says 「The characters look great! Ready to create the storyboard?」 with a priced Create storyboard card; every charge goes through an offer (MX). TC-044 (P9-b1, all switches Off): Borrowed Rain, cast set, Done ✓ 17:18 → no storyboard offer; instead 「Continuing character portrait generation.」, a re-written outline card and at 17:25 「Something went wrong on my end.」; Try again 17:28 failed again at 17:37. The pill dropped 19034 → 19000 → 18996 and the ledger booked a run of Text to Image −3 plus Text to Speech −1 (= −34) at 17:22–17:25 and −3/−1 at 17:35, with no offer, no Generate tap and no refund; the phone log has no Permission authorize line for those charges (excerpt: the turn begins and fails, nothing authorized). O-36 (video gate, 05:25): 綴じられた秘密's video card showed ◆131 — log 'authorize tools=[RefToVideox2,TextToImagex3,TextToSpeechx2] credit=131': the pending 「Update characters」 work was folded into the video price without saying so; the video failed and −1/−3 stayed booked (refund: ISS-AMD-63). The turn failures themselves are the storage upload of ISS-AMD-71.

AI-Mini-Drama-P9-07.qa_note: Seen in four dramas, all switches Off. O-9 (P9-b1 16:59): after leaving Choose Character the chat ends in a user bubble 「Generate with AI」 the user never typed. O-11 (Keeper's Light 21:39): Confirm on 「Your characters are ready」 → 「…2 characters still have no portrait…」, a 「Generate with AI」 user bubble, then 「Something went wrong」 after 423 s. O-37 (Dawn Bread 06:22): Confirm → the phantom 「Generate with AI」 bubble, 「I have created the complete 6-beat storyboard for 'Dawn Bread'…」 and 「Advancing the mini drama production.」 for 387 s, then nothing (card=none, character-sync storage PUT failed 06:28:08); later 「The full 6-beat storyboard … has been created」 again before the ◆28 offer. AI-Mini-Drama-P9-08.title: Chat character change: one option chip, non-spec copy and no updated-cast messages
AI-Mini-Drama-P9-08.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent][UI] AI Mini Drama: Character change in chat offers one chip and skips the update messages
AI-Mini-Drama-P9-08.desc:

摘要：Iris 只提供一個角色選項，文案與規格不同，更新後也沒有「Here's your updated cast.」等訊息。
{16.9.0_amd57_one_chip.jpg} {16.9.0_amd57_no_working.jpg} {16.9.0_amd57_closing_line.jpg} {16.9.0_amd57_after_storyboard.jpg}

摘要：Iris 應以規格文案詢問並為每位角色提供選項，更新後顯示規格中的進度與完成訊息。
Spec string: 「Sure! Which character would you like to change?」 / 「Working on it...」 / 「Here's your updated cast.」 / 「Your characters' looks are updated! Ready to create the storyboard?」

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama PM spec (AI Mini Drama - PM Spec 20261021.pdf), Update board 7 board - https://www.figma.com/design/44RyrcOcWi2MvhGci9bO5F/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2016-2
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-P9-08.qa_note: R-254 / R-090 (PM Update board 7, 10/16): 「Sure! Which character would you like to change?」 with 2–4 chips; after Generate 「Working on it...」, then 「Here's your updated cast.」 and 「Your characters' looks are updated! Ready to create the storyboard?」; after a cast change 「Characters updated! Regenerate the storyboard to match?」. On 189872 (all Off; TC-348 20:39 and 20:48): 「Which character would you like to make look older?」 with ONE chip (Clara) and 「More ideas +」 — Julian never offered; tapping the chip removes the question line too. TC-349: Generate shows 「Thinking…」 then 「Advancing drama production to the next stage.」, never 「Working on it...」, and ends with 「The characters look great! Ready to create the storyboard?」 (no 「Here's your updated cast.」); Clara still looks the same (not visibly older). TC-352 (Art of Falling after a storyboard): ends with 「Characters updated! Regenerate the storyboard to match?」 instead of 「Your characters' looks are updated!…」. TC-103 (The Gambit, cast changed at the storyboard offer): Iris repeats 「The characters look great!…」. The chat replies come from the Iris engine on the device, so RD owns them. Related DRI261896P0054 (wrong prompt after a cast change following a storyboard).
